name: Epic Rakshasa Hide
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Rakshasa Hide

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Roar
effects.tooltip: Roar : This item emits a frightening roar when melee attackers score a critical hit on the wearer, causing them to resist or be shaken with fear.

effects.name: Heightened Awareness
effects.tooltip: Heightened Awareness 4 : This item helps you to quickly read situations with sharpness and clarity, allowing you to predict actions before they occur. You gain a +4 Insight bonus to AC.

effects.name: Superior Nimbleness
effects.tooltip: Superior Nimbleness : This suit of armor looks much less restrictive than others of its type. A suit of armor that has this property has a maximum Dexterity bonus 4 higher than normal, and its armor check penalty is reduced by 4.

effects.name: Accuracy
effects.tooltip: Accuracy +15 : Passive: +15 Competence bonus to attack rolls

effects.name: Rough Hide
effects.tooltip: Rough Hide +3 : This item fuses with your body and toughens your skin, providing a +3 Primal bonus to your natural armor.

flavor_text: Crafted from the tanned hide of a Rakshasa, this armor is lightweight and grants many of the magical traits and supernatural senses that a Rakshasa possesses.
